title: Send your first successful request through GodarAI
subtitle: To quickly configure your workspace, follow the customized instructions below.

planHints.developer: Your path focuses on connecting a provider, creating a PAT, and sending the first request so you can start testing quickly.
planHints.team: For the Team plan, quick start also focuses on service identity and baseline policies so your setup is operational from day one.
planHints.growth: On the Growth plan, guardrails join the journey after identity and policy setup so your stack is closer to production.
planHints.enterprise: For Enterprise, quick start also covers teams and governance controls alongside the technical setup.

progress.estimate: About {minutes} minutes to your first successful request

messages.patCreated: A new personal token was created and the page snippets were updated with it.
messages.sampleRequestSucceeded: The sample request successfully passed through your tenant endpoint.

journey.title: Recommended journey for this plan
journey.description: Step order is derived from the real state of your tenant and changes by plan.

blocked.feature: This step is not enabled in your current tenant entitlements.
blocked.permission: Your current role does not appear to have the required access for this step.
blocked.prerequisite: This section becomes available after you complete the earlier steps.

connect_provider.title: Connect your first provider account
connect_provider.description: Without upstream credentials, GodarAI has nothing to route. Start by connecting a valid provider account.
connect_provider.learn: A provider account is the secure connection to the model provider, not your application token.

create_pat.title: Create a personal access token
create_pat.description: For the fastest first test, create a PAT so this page can generate ready-to-run snippets for you.
create_pat.learn: A PAT belongs to a user and is a strong fit for quick testing, personal tools, and first-run onboarding.

create_service_identity.title: Create a service identity and VAT
create_service_identity.description: For team and production workflows, it is better to use a virtual user and virtual access token instead of a personal token.
create_service_identity.learn: A VAT is the token for your application or service, not for a human user.

create_rate_limit_rule.title: Define your first rate limit
create_rate_limit_rule.description: Set a sensible request-rate ceiling early so runtime behavior stays controlled.
create_rate_limit_rule.learn: Rate limiting controls bursts and protects you from sudden request spikes.

create_budget_limit_rule.title: Define your first budget limit
create_budget_limit_rule.description: Set a spending ceiling so your costs stay predictable from the first day.
create_budget_limit_rule.learn: Budget policy controls cost, while rate policy controls request intensity.

create_guardrail.title: Add your first guardrail
create_guardrail.description: If your plan includes it, add a baseline guardrail so the pipeline is not only functional, but safer too.
create_guardrail.learn: A guardrail can validate or mutate content before or after the model call.

create_team.title: Create your first team
create_team.description: Before usage expands, organize ownership and access through teams.
create_team.learn: A team is a layer for assigning access, allowed models, and service identities to a group.

send_first_request.title: Send your first request
send_first_request.description: Once your provider and model are ready, use the test bench on this page and run a real sample call.
send_first_request.learn: Quick start becomes real when your request passes through your own tenant endpoint.

inspect_activity.title: Inspect the result in telemetry
inspect_activity.description: After sending a request, move to logs, traces, or metrics and see the real execution path.
inspect_activity.learn: The gateway's value is not just making the call. It is also what you can observe and control after the call.

lab.title: First-request test bench
lab.description: This is the fastest path to a real call against your tenant endpoint. If you already have a fresh secret, paste it and use the ready snippets.
lab.recommendedPat: For this plan, PAT is the fastest way to start and experiment.
lab.recommendedVat: For this plan, VAT is the production path, but PAT can still be a useful shortcut for quick testing.
lab.notReadyTitle: The test bench is not ready yet
lab.notReadyProvider: You need at least one active provider account before we can suggest a model and build a real snippet.
lab.notReadyModels: No allowed model was found for this key type yet. Finish the setup or refresh and try again.

lab.generatedTokenDescription: If you just created a PAT, you can use it directly in this page's snippets or copy it separately.

placeholderHint.vat: If you still see the placeholder, temporarily paste the VAT secret you just created.

patDialog.title: Create a PAT for quick start
patDialog.description: This token is created for fast testing and immediate snippet generation on this page.

provider_accounts.title: Provider accounts
provider_accounts.description: Manage credentials, effective models, and upstream connection health in one place.

virtual_users.title: Service identities
virtual_users.description: Create virtual users and VATs so applications connect to GodarAI with their own identity.

teams.title: Teams
teams.description: Organize access, ownership, and allowed models around real business teams.

guardrails.title: Guardrails
guardrails.description: Add safety and validation controls before production traffic arrives.

prompts.title: Prompt registry
prompts.description: Separate prompt templates, versions, and variables from application code.

metrics.title: Metrics
metrics.description: See consumption, latency, and model behavior from both operational and business angles.

logs.title: Logs
logs.description: Follow the details of real requests for debugging and runtime analysis.

billing_plan.title: Plan and capacity
billing_plan.description: Check your tenant's plan and the features and limits it actually includes.
